_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a defined reference baseline of bugfest environment (currently 3 standalone tenants, and 11 consortia tenants). See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file.

deployment.description: Deployment configuration for the backend module. Adjust replicas based on expected load and HA requirements. The scheduled cache-invalidation job (RTAC_CACHE_INVALIDATION_CRON) runs unguarded per replica; concurrent runs are idempotent deletes, so HA is safe without a distributed lock.

kong.description: Custom Kong proxy timeouts. Read timeout is raised above the 60s default because a cache-miss request synchronously fans out to inventory/circulation/orders to lazily generate the RTAC cache before responding.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical FOLIO deployment name used as the prefix for Kafka topic patterns and Kafka consumer groups.

EnvVars.name: okapi_url
EnvVars.description: Okapi base URL used for outbound FOLIO service calls and system-user requests. Must be provided by the deployment environment.

EnvVars.name: secure_store
EnvVars.description: Type of secure store used for tenant credentials. Valid values: Ephemeral, AwsSsm, Vault.

EnvVars.name: secure_store_props
EnvVars.description: Path to a properties file specifying the secure store configuration.

EnvVars.name: log_level
EnvVars.description: Log4j log level for the module.

EnvVars.name: token_cache_ttl_ms
EnvVars.description: How long to cache JWTs, in milliseconds.

EnvVars.name: null_token_cache_ttl_ms
EnvVars.description: How long to cache a failed (null) token lookup, in milliseconds, before retrying.

EnvVars.name: token_cache_capacity
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of entries in the token cache.
